answer: A sybil-resistant economy can age every identity like a vine that only bears fruit after seasons of steady care: reputation accrues slowly from verified work and decays when idle, so a fresh swarm of clones starts at zero and cannot buy history. The failure mode is a patient attacker farming idle accounts for months, then activating them together. The check is to audit each account's work history at the wharf where value lands, tracing every claim back to real completed tasks, and let a falcon-eyed reviewer sample the trail at random before any reward is released.
